cases.name: Michelle Bock-Caswell
cases.about: She was a cashier at Pilot and Flying J Travel Centers.
cases.narrative: Witnesses told detectives they heard Michelle screaming for help. They ran to help her but found Jarvy on top of her and he had her in a chokehold, and they yelled at him to stop. Jarvy refused, and the witnesses began fighting with him to keep him away from Michelle, who was unconscious. When deputies arrived, she was dead.
